symbols.name: SummaryCard
symbols.sig: export function SummaryCard({ summary, onOpenSource }: { summary: NonNullable<AnswerState["summary"]>; onOpenSource: OpenSource })
doc: The summary every circular or announcement reply carries when no precise answer could be proved (documentSummary.ts). I make it say what the best match is about, and say so plainly when it does not answer the question, and, when the model could not write one, show the opening of the document in its own words, labelled as that.

symbols.name: CircularAnswerCard
symbols.sig: export function CircularAnswerCard({ state, onOpenSource }: { state: AnswerState; onOpenSource: OpenSource })
doc: `type` says what the source is: a circular opens in its viewer, an announcement in its own window, and the search window comes back when it is closed.

behaviours: with two sources, each row says which circular it comes from and when
an ALL-CAPS headline is tidied on the row line exactly as in the Sources list
with one source, the rows carry no source line (it is the Source box below)
a long headline is cut
a row whose source is not listed shows nothing instead of failing
the caveat shows only when a row is the assistant's wording
the note is shown
single figure: a column that repeats the label is not shown twice
single figure: a column that adds something is still shown
table: a repeated sub-label is dropped, a different one is kept
Open circular: each source opens on its own row's page and words
Open circular: a source no row cites opens with no words and the source's own page
Open circular: no page anywhere gives null, not a crash
an answer from an announcement: its title is plain text, not a link and not a button (the way in is the Source row)
the source row of an announcement opens it too, named 'Open announcement', with the megaphone
the announcement opens at the page of the PDF the answer came from (the answer's own page), and with the words when it has them
a circular's answer is as before: its title is plain text and its row says 'Open circular'
a holiday note is still not openable

the search window opens an announcement from the answer in its own window, at that page, and does not touch the circular viewer; closing the window brings the search back as it was (its state is kept; the box is only hidden)
a reply with no precise answer carries a summary card: the text, the document it comes from and the button to open it
when the document does not answer the question the card says so plainly, and tells the reader to check
a summary that does answer carries no warning, and an announcement opens as an announcement
the opening of a document (no written summary was available) is labelled as that, in the header and in a note
a precise answer is shown as before and no summary card appears beside it
with neither an answer nor a summary (no text at all) nothing is drawn, as before
the loading card still says Loading Summary while either is being made
